messages.subject: RE: Project Northwind — A&R Agreement — Bank's mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

The Bank's comments are attached as a redline. The key moves: Facility A margin to 4.50%, Facility B to 6.75%, RCF to 4.25%; amendment fee to £325k and exit fee to 1.25%; leverage tightened to 3.25x stepping to 2.75x; DSCR to 1.15x from the September test; and minimum liquidity to £1.75m. The longstop is pulled to 31 July to match the forbearance.

Most of this is credit-driven. We expect there is a deal to be done in the middle on pricing and the liquidity floor.

Claire
